notes: GENERAL: USD millions; FY = 52/53 weeks ending Sunday nearest 31-Dec. FY2009 had 53 weeks (ended 3-Jan-2010; Q4-09 had 14 weeks); FY2006 ended 31-Dec-2006, FY2007 30-Dec-2007, FY2008 28-Dec-2008, FY2010 2-Jan-2011, FY2011 1-Jan-2012, FY2012 30-Dec-2012.

IS SOURCES (latest 10-K presenting full IS): 2012 FY2014 10-K; 2011 FY2013 10-K; 2010 FY2012 10-K; 2009 FY2011 10-K; 2008 FY2010 10-K; 2007 FY2009 10-K (latest presenting 2007, already on SFAS 160/ASC 810 NCI presentation); 2006 FY2008 10-K. All figures identical to the original-year 10-K for 2010-2012.

TCM / DISCONTINUED OPS: In Dec-2010 Teledyne agreed to sell its general aviation piston engine businesses (Teledyne Continental Motors + Teledyne Mattituck Services = former Aerospace Engines and Components segment); the FY2010 10-K (filed Mar-2011) already restated 2008-2010 to show AEC as discontinued ops and held for sale; sale closed 19-Apr-2011 for $186.0m (pretax cash proceeds $187.9m net of $1.9m costs), gain $113.8m after $73.5m tax. So IS for 2008-2012 is continuing-ops (TCM excluded). IS for 2006 and 2007 is PRE-recast and INCLUDES TCM in continuing ops (no 10-K re-presents a full 2006/2007 IS ex-TCM). AEC/TCM sales: 2006 181.6, 2007 180.7, 2008 171.0, 2009 113.1, 2010 133.7, 2011 39.5 (to 19-Apr). 2011 disc_ops 113.1 = operating loss (0.7) + gain 113.8; 2012 disc_ops 2.3 = finalization of income tax benefits on the sale. 2008 disc ops loss (5.3) includes the Feb-2009 TCM cylinder recall charge ($18.0m pretax, recorded in FY2008 as a subsequent event via 8-K/A of 26-Feb-2009, which cut the originally released FY2008 NI from $122.2m to $111.3m).

RECAST CONTINUING OPS (ops keys): FY2010 10-K Selected Financial Data gives continuing-ops sales 2007 1,441.6 and 2006 1,251.6 and continuing diluted EPS 2007 2.36 / 2006 1.99 (basic 2.45 / 2.06); FY2011 10-K Selected Data gives 2007 net income from continuing ops 85.6 and disc ops 12.9 (2007 NI 98.5). FY2011/FY2012 10-K give 2008 continuing sales 1,722.0 / income 116.6 / disc ops (5.3) (same as the FY2010 10-K IS). 2006 continuing income in $ is not disclosed (only EPS).

NCI / SFAS 160: Pre-2009 statements (FY2006-FY2008 10-Ks) deducted 'minority interest' above pretax income. 2007 is taken from the FY2009 10-K which re-presented it per SFAS 160 (pretax 152.7 = 149.3 as originally reported + 3.4 minority interest). For 2006 (only available pre-SFAS 160, FY2008 10-K) I re-presented on the same basis: pretax 122.7 = reported 121.7 + minority interest 1.0, net_income incl. NCI 81.3, nci 1.0, ni_teledyne 80.3 (key pretax_as_reported = 121.7). Tax unchanged. Minority interest related mainly to Ocean Design Inc. (majority interest acquired Aug-2006, redeemable NCI) and Teledyne Energy Systems minority holders.

income_cont = net income from continuing ops INCLUDING NCI (as captioned in 10-K); income_cont_teledyne = attributable to Teledyne. For 2006/2007 income_cont = net income (all operations, incl. TCM, were continuing at the time).

IS LINE DEFINITIONS: Teledyne IS shows Sales, Cost of sales, SG&A (incl. company-funded R&D and B&P), 'Income before other income and expense and income taxes' (= op_income), Interest and debt expense net, Other income (expense) net. No other_op lines 2006-2012. op_income = net_sales - cost_sales - sga ties every year. rd_company = company-funded R&D + bid & proposal costs (10-K note): 2008/2009 restated ex-TCM in FY2010/FY2011 10-K (61.5/58.8 vs 65.6/60.8 originally); 2006 52.5 per FY2008 10-K notes (FY2006 10-K Item 1 quoted $55.5m incl. B&P on a different basis). rd_customer = customer-funded R&D charged to cost of sales.

MEMO: da = CF D&A (continuing ops from 2008). depreciation & amort_intangibles from 10-K PP&E / intangibles notes: 2008/2009 depreciation restated ex-TCM in FY2010/FY2011 10-K (29.2/30.1; originally 31.5/32.4 incl. TCM). 2010: depreciation 30.6 + amortization 14.1 = 44.7 vs CF D&A 45.2 (0.5 unexplained, likely other amortization). sbc = 'stock option expense' CF line (SFAS 123R adopted 2-Jan-2006; no SBC expense before 2006). pension_expense = pension expense included in operating profit per 10-K MD&A (2006-2008 total SFAS 87; 2008 9.0 ex-TCM per FY2010 10-K, 9.6 originally; 2009-2012 'domestic pension expense' ex-TCM; 2010 excludes $0.1m Intelek UK plan, 2009/2010 exclude $1.1m/$0.4m in disc ops). pension_cas_recovery = pension cost recoverable under US Gov CAS (offset in pricing). capex = CF PP&E purchases (continuing ops from 2008).

SEGMENTS - CURRENT BASIS: FY2010 10-K realigned former Electronics & Communications into Instrumentation, Digital Imaging, A&DE; Energy & Power Systems split (batteries -> A&DE; energy systems + turbine engines -> Engineered Systems) and restated 2008-2009 (AEC -> disc ops). 2008 from FY2010 10-K, 2009 from FY2011 10-K, 2010 from FY2012 10-K. FY2013 10-K (Q2-2013) moved two interconnect businesses (energy markets) from A&DE to Instrumentation (marine line) and restated 2011-2012; FY2014 10-K repeats for 2012. Per latest-filing rule 2011 is from the FY2013 10-K and 2012 from the FY2014 10-K, so 2011-12 are on the post-2013 basis while 2008-2010 are NOT restated for that move (basis break 2010->2011: transferred units had sales $31.6m in 2011 and $55.3m in 2012). Pre-2013-recast (FY2012 10-K) values: 2011 sales inst 616.6 / ade 670.8, OI inst 122.8 / ade 93.9, D&A inst 16.3 / ade 16.9, capex inst 8.9 / ade 13.1, assets inst 545.0 / ade 479.3, marine 372.8; 2012 sales inst 749.4 / ade 660.6, OI inst 136.2 / ade 90.3, D&A inst 23.5 / ade 19.7, capex inst 13.2 / ade 13.8, assets inst 945.9 / ade 534.2, marine 418.4. DI and ES unchanged.

SEGMENT RECONCILIATION: segment OI ('segment operating profit and other segment income') - corporate expense = consolidated op_income in every year 2007-2012 (other_seg = 0). Segment OP excludes NCI, interest, gains/losses on asset dispositions, sublease income, non-revenue licensing/royalty income and corporate office expense. FY2012 and FY2013/14 10-K segment D&A label for 2008-2010 in FY2010 10-K reads 'Digital Imaging and Instrumentation' (typo, it is Digital Imaging). assets_disc = identifiable assets of discontinued operations (TCM) in segment table (2009: 90.1 in segment table vs 90.2 held-for-sale on BS). capex_corp 0 where filing shows '—' or omits the corporate line with segment items summing to total. 2011 inst_etm 0 ('—'): T&M line began with LeCroy (Aug-2012).

PRODUCT LINES: Instrumentation = Environmental Instrumentation (inst_env), Marine Instrumentation (inst_marine), Test and Measurement Instrumentation (inst_etm, from 2012). Engineered Systems = 'Engineered Products and Services' (es_eng), 'Turbine Engines' (es_turbine), 'Energy Systems' (es_energy). DI and A&DE are single product lines. Not disclosed on this basis for 2006-2007. FY2014 10-K moved one business ($9.4m 2013 sales) from env to T&M from Q1-2014 — affects 2013 only, not 2012.

SEGMENTS - LEGACY BASIS (leg_*): ec = Electronics and Communications, ses = Engineered Systems (named Systems Engineering Solutions until Q4-2007), aec = Aerospace Engines and Components (TCM + until 2007 turbine engines), eps = Energy and Power Systems (formed Q4-2007 from Teledyne Energy Systems, Teledyne Turbine Engines, Teledyne Battery Products). 2006 from FY2008 10-K (on the post-Q4-2007 realigned basis; the FY2006 10-K originally showed E&C / Systems Engineering Solutions / AEC incl. turbine engines / Energy Systems), 2007 and 2008-2009 'as originally reported' from FY2009 10-K. Legacy figures INCLUDE TCM and reconcile to the pre-recast consolidated totals (2008: sales 1,893.0 / op income 188.9; 2009: 1,765.2 / 166.0), NOT to the recast IS above. 2006 leg_other = -2.5: segment OP (AEC) included $2.5m receipts under an expired Honda Motor agreement that the IS reports in other income (IS other income 5.0 vs 2.5 in reconciliation). leg_da/capex/assets_* from the same tables.

OPS: funded_backlog = 'total backlog of confirmed orders' (Item 1; Teledyne does not label it funded); 2008/2009 restated ex-TCM in FY2010 10-K (822.5/812.5 vs 842.8/831.0 originally, keys *_as_orig); 2006-2007 include TCM. sales_us_gov = total US Government sales (prime + sub) from 10-K; segment splits sales_us_gov_* (current basis) and leg_sales_us_gov_* (legacy; AEC had none). US Gov totals 2008/2009 unchanged by the TCM recast. sales_dod = DoD portion. sales_intl = total sales to international customers (destination; 2008/2009 restated ex-TCM in FY2010 10-K: 418.8/427.7 vs 450.3/455.8), sales_export_us_ops = portion shipped from US operations. rev_origin_* = sales by country of origin (2009 FY2011 10-K, 2010 FY2012 10-K, 2011 FY2013 10-K, 2012 FY2014 10-K which splits UK out). Pre-2009 10-Ks only say >95% of sales made by US operations. employees = 'total current workforce' at 10-K filing date (approx.): FY2010 10-K 9,200 includes ~1,000 DALSA employees (acquired Feb-2011) and ~400 in discontinued ops.
